caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned dark-toned candlestick with a flared circular base, a long narrowing stem, and a wider upper section, rendered in pencil or graphite on a beige or light tan background. The candlestick is shown in a frontal view within a large, lightly outlined rectangular box. In the upper left corner of the composition, there is a smaller rectangular inset containing a simple, linear version of the candlestick with its height dimensioned as "9½" inches. In the lower right corner, another small box contains a top-down schematic circle with concentric rings, possibly representing the candlestick’s top view. The artist’s name, "Eugene J. Barsotti," is written in small, neat script beneath the large box. The overall arrangement is clean and geometric, with a focus on technical representation.
title: Candlestick
